sources.title: USDA FoodData Central SR Legacy, food.csv + food_portion.csv (household-measure gram weights)
sources.publisher: USDA Agricultural Research Service, FoodData Central
sources.note: Used only for unit conversions of BLS series quoted in non-kg units: Egg, whole, raw, fresh (fdc_id 171287): 1 large = 50 g; Milk, whole, 3.25% milkfat (fdc_id 171265): 1 quart = 976 g.

data.method: Consumer-level loss percentages come from USDA ERS TB-1927 tables 3-9: the 'proposed consumer loss estimate' where RTI published one, otherwise the 'previous consumer loss estimate' (the assumption carried in the ERS LAFA series), which the note on each row states. Edible shares come from USDA ARS SR28 FOOD_DES refuse percentages (100 minus refuse). These factors are for purchased-grams -> edible-grams translation and display ONLY; the waste model never multiplies them into waste or savings totals, because the inventory event stream already records the observed outcome (see model.md).
